messages:
megan: Quick sync — we need to lock down the Prom/OTel labels for the routing + quotas dashboards before I wire the console. thinking about cardinality and what runtime actually emits.

arjun: Agreed. main ask: dashboards need route, model, region, and a stable customer signal (but not high-cardinality freeform).

kai: +1. we should avoid raw customer_id on Prom metrics. prefer customer_tier + sampled_customer_hash for heavy customers.

lisa: For routing, we also want 'route_type' (api vs internal-batch) and 'priority' (realtime vs background). reduces need for downstream joins.

samir: Runtime note: current agent emits attributes: service, route, model, model_version, region, node_pool, raw_customer_id. we can change agent to emit customer_tier and hashed_customer_id on request.

megan: Proposal (minimal label set): service, route, route_type, model, model_version (coarse), region, pool, customer_tier, sampled_customer_hash. Keep model_version low-cardinality by truncating to yyyy-mm tag.

arjun: +1 on truncating model_version. Do we have any existing OTel -> Prom relabeling rules?

kai: We do basic relabeling in pipeline: drop attributes over length 128, map attributes to labels via mapping.yaml. But there is no cardinality gate today.

megan: Can we add a relabel rule to drop raw_customer_id unless a flag (high_telemetry_customers) is set? we should also add a PR check to schema-registry.

samir: doable. simplest pattern: in pipeline config: 
```
- action: keep
  regex: (service|route|model|model_version|region|pool|customer_tier|sampled_customer_hash|route_type|priority)
- action: drop
  regex: .*customer_id.*
```
But we should avoid regex brittleness. better to explicit-allow.

lisa: For dashboards, we'll need label fallbacks for historical data. e.g., if model_version missing, use model tag only. handle in query layer.

arjun: Also: name conventions. We prefer prometheus-style metric names: redwood_runtime_requests_total, redwood_runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket. Labels use snake_case. OTel attributes should be mapped consistently.

megan: Agreed. Let's standardize on: metric prefix = redwood_runtime_, labels in snake_case, model_version -> model_version_tag, sampled_customer_hash -> cust_hash. keep list in docs.

kai: One more constraint: cardinality budget per metric. ops-sre suggested <500 unique label combos for route+model per cluster for 1m scrape cardinality. We should document per-metric budgets.

samir: On the runtime side, I'll implement sampling for sampled_customer_hash: only include if customer is in telemetry whitelist OR 1% random sampling. Also will emit model_version_tag by truncating the git tag.

megan: Great. Owner notes: samir updates runtime agent, arjun adds relabel rules in ingest pipeline, kai adds schema-registry gate, lisa prototypes dashboards using the minimal label set. I'll own the console wiring.

megan: Quick example of desired Prom metric + labels for dashboards:
```
redwood_runtime_requests_total{service="runtime", route="/v1/generate", route_type="api", model="gpt-4o", model_version_tag="4o-2025-06", region="us-west1", pool="dedicated-A", customer_tier="enterprise", cust_hash="h659c..."}
```

arjun: Example OTel attr mapping for agent SDK: 
```
otel.attributes: {
  "service.name": "service",
  "http.route": "route",
  "redwood.model": "model",
  "redwood.model.version": "model_version_tag",
  "cloud.region": "region",
  "redwood.pool": "pool",
  "redwood.customer.tier": "customer_tier",
  "redwood.customer.hash": "cust_hash",
  "redwood.route.type": "route_type",
}
```

kai: For the schema registry gate: PRs must include a cardinality estimate (promql sample or histogram) and an explicit list of labels. CI should fail if any proposed label is marked 'freeform' or exceeds a whitelist.

lisa: For dashboard UX: add a 'cardinality warning' banner when any chosen filter would expand the cardinality above budget, with automatic suggestion to switch to aggregated view.

samir: I'll send a runtime PR today to change attributes and add a feature flag for raw_customer_id. Also will add a unit test verifying model_version truncation.

megan: Action items summary: 
- samir: runtime agent PR (emit new attrs + sampling) ✅
- arjun: ingest relabel + pipeline rule PR (explicit allow list) ✅
- kai: schema-registry CI gate for cardinality + label whitelist ✅
- lisa: dashboard prototype and agg fallback UX by EOD Thu ✅
- megan: console wiring + docs for naming conventions by next Tue ✅

ingest-bot: CI Status: no pipeline changes yet.

megan: Thanks all — will post the minimal label spec doc in #eng-platform/docs and open the schema issue. ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
